_arch_note: exp_g_0027 (exp_g_0026 + one CompressionMHL immediately before the unembedder) with ONE change: the pre-unembedder slot is WIDENED from inner dim 48 to 64 -- head_lut_inner_in_dim 48->64, head_lut_inner_out_dim 48->64, head_lut_n_heads pinned at 8 (the value it already had, stated explicitly). Everything else is held identical to exp_g_0027: same LayerNorm-before-LUT (head_ln, a separate LayerNorm((384,), eps=1e-5, affine) matching the FFN slots' ln2), same pre-norm + residual shape x = x + head_ffn(head_ln(x)) then logits = head(ln_f(x)), same zero-initialized decompress so the layer is the identity at step 0, same nap 7, tph 128, forward_mode hard, learnable_temps, init noise, seed 1006. CRUCIALLY the 6 FFN slots stay at inner 48 -- head_lut_* keys size the head slot alone, so inner dim on that ONE slot is the single variable. Everything else held: depth 6, n_embd 384, n_head 6, seq 512, vocab 32768, 16,000 steps, 24,576 tok/step, untied head, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, seed 1. Anchors: exp_g_0027 (direct parent, 74,825,486 params), exp_g_0026 1.1949408 (68,237,580), exp_n_0083 1.1892311, exp_n_0045 1.1977670.
_mem_note: device_batch_size 24 / grad_accum 2 inherited unchanged from exp_g_0027 (effective batch 24,576 tokens identical). REQUIRES PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True at launch. First launch attempt OOM'd before step 1: it needed 6.00 GiB for the LUT backward surrogate [12288, 1024, 128] fp32 with 5.62 GiB free, while 7.13 GiB sat reserved-but-unallocated as allocator fragmentation. expandable_segments collapses that gap to 0.4 GiB and the run fits: peak 24.57 GiB allocated / 24.98 GiB reserved on a 31.4 GiB card, 6.4 GiB headroom, measured over a full real training step (grad_accum 2, real data) PLUS a real evaluate_bpb. It changes allocator behaviour only -- the math and the effective batch are untouched. Note the widened head slot does NOT widen the [N, n_tables, 2^nap] surrogate (inner dim is the VALUE width, not the key width); the extra memory over exp_g_0027's 23.54 GiB is ~1 GiB of wider values, which is what pushed a run that already sat near the ceiling over it. The first smoke MISSED this because it ran one micro-batch per backward instead of the real grad_accum=2 loop and never touched the eval path; the smoke now replicates both.
_head_slot_note: These three keys size the pre-unembedder slot ONLY. Every head_lut_* key falls back to the matching lut_* value, so the 6 FFN slots stay at inner_in/out 48 exactly as in exp_g_0027 and exp_g_0026 -- they are never touched by a head_lut_* override. nap (7), tables_per_head (128), forward_mode, learnable_temps, joint_head_compression, init noise and base seed are all inherited unchanged, so inner dim is the single variable.
